summary.en: Octapharma develops plasma-derived and recombinant protein therapies across hematology, immunotherapy and critical care. Reviewed disclosures emphasize existing-product development; no asset meeting the brief’s inclusion rules was verified.
summary.zh: Octapharma在血液学、免疫治疗和重症监护领域开发血浆来源及重组蛋白疗法。所审阅的披露内容侧重于现有产品开发；未核实到符合简报纳入规则的资产。

watch.en: Plasma collection underpins the portfolio; management identifies recombinant FVIII as the exception to donor dependence.
watch.zh: 血浆采集是产品组合的基础；管理层指出重组FVIII是摆脱对献血者依赖的例外。

watch.en: Management highlights immunoglobulin infection prevention in CLL, but a submitted label-expansion application and decision date were not verified.
watch.zh: 管理层强调免疫球蛋白可预防CLL感染，但未核实到已提交的标签扩展申请及决定日期。

watch.en: 2025 operating cash flow was EUR661 million, with EUR117 million of R&D and EUR331 million of capital expenditure.
watch.zh: 2025年经营现金流为6.61亿欧元，研发支出1.17亿欧元，资本支出3.31亿欧元。

watch.en: Management identifies the US as the main 2025 growth driver, particularly immunoglobulins, FVIII and four-factor PCC.
watch.zh: 管理层指出美国是2025年的主要增长驱动力，尤其是免疫球蛋白、FVIII和四因子PCC。

gaps: No eligible unapproved clinical asset was verified. The current R&D page names Phase IV GENA studies, which are outside the requested stages.
The shareholder review describes an expected immunoglobulin label expansion for CLL, but a filing status, numbered development phase and decision date were not established.
No current company-wide phase totals were verified; counts is null.
The latest group financial review located was published February 17, 2026 and covers 2025; it predates June 2026. The R&D page is undated.
